Res.Caption: Account Type
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Charge Type or Select from the Charge Type Listing. BSH - Balance Sheet Account. P&L - Profit & Loss Account. TTL - Total, an Account that totals up P&L, BSH or ALT type accounts. HDR - Header, an Account that is a Header or Notation Account. CLN - Consolidation Account, an account to which other accounts are accumulated, but are not added into the totals. ALT - Alternate, an Account used to display a Negative Asset as a Positive Liability e.g. an overdrawn Bank Account. NTE - Note, an Account that is a Statistical Units of Measurement Account.

Res.Caption: Alternate Number
Res.FullDescription: This is used where an Account such as Bank may go into overdraft. To correctly show the account as a positive Liability instead of a negative Asset, use an Alternate account.

Res.Caption: Consolidation Number
Res.FullDescription: This option can be used where it is required to show further information in addition to that shown in the P&L or Balance Sheet.

Res.Caption: Percent Number
Res.FullDescription: Enter the GL Account of which this account is to show a Percentage of.

Res.Caption: Control Account
Res.FullDescription: Untick if the account is a standard account and not a Control Account. Tick if the account is a Debtors/Creditors Control Account or something similar: e.g. Accrual/WIP Controls, Journals Control, GST Tax Controls, GST Tax Rates Controls, Bank Accounts, Exchange Gain/Loss. These accounts must be set up as Control Accounts and no Charge Codes should be linked to these Accounts.

Res.Caption: Debit/Credit
Res.FullDescription: DR signifies that the balance in this Account would normally be a Debit balance. CR signifies a balance that is normally a Credit.

Res.Caption: Account Name
Res.FullDescription: Enter a short description for the GL Account Name

Res.Caption: Print Sequence
Res.FullDescription: If the GL report is to display this account in a different sequence to the G/L Number, enter a number between 0 & 999.

Res.Caption: Total Level
Res.FullDescription: Enter the total level of the current GL Account. This field is only used when the Account Type is TTL. TTL accounts sum P&L, BSH and ALT Accounts. A TTL account sums all preceding GL accounts until another TTL account with an equal or greater Total Level is encountered. The general principle is that GL Accounts are summed in order of their Account code. TTL accounts are used to sub total and total General Ledger reports.
